requirement: Create a pathogen: map the command to the entity, persist it, and return the new id with Created status.

preconditions.text: The pathogen table is empty for the case

inputs.text: Atypical pathogen 'Pseudomonas arguresia' with a description
Non-atypical pathogen 'H. influzae' with a description
Atypical pathogen 'abc' with a short description

returns.text: Success with Created status and the new pathogen id
The pathogen is persisted with its name, description, and atypical flag

exception_text: No unhandled exception; the mapper always returns a successful result
